# River City Dance Studio

> Ballroom and Latin partner-dance studio in San Antonio, Texas. Bilingual (English/Spanish) instruction, senior-friendly community, beginner public classes every Tuesday and Friday at 7:00 PM. In business for 45+ years.

River City Dance Studio is a family-owned dance school in central San Antonio, Texas. Current owners Chi & Cristine Diaz are longtime instructors who took over the studio to continue its 45-year legacy in the community. The studio specializes in social partner dancing rooted in South Texas culture: Tejano, Cumbia, Country Western Two-Step, Latin (Salsa & Bachata), Swing, and special-occasion choreography (weddings, quinceañeras, anniversaries).

## Location & contact

- Address: 3534 Fredericksburg Rd #24, San Antonio, TX 78201
- Phone: (210) 810-2224
- Languages: English and Spanish (bilingual instruction)
- Payments: All card transactions processed via Square (credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Cash accepted at the door.

## Class schedule

- Tuesday, 7:00 PM — Beginner public class (no partner required, all levels)
- Friday, 7:00 PM — Beginner public class (no partner required, all levels)
- Private lessons by appointment (single or couple)

## Pricing

- $145 Starter Bundle — two drop-in public classes plus one private lesson (best value)
- Public drop-in class — price posted at the studio (call to confirm)
- Private lesson, single person — contact for pricing
- Private lesson, couple — contact for pricing
- Studio rental — submit the rental form for availability and rates

## Services

- Beginner-friendly group classes
- Private lessons for individuals and couples
- Senior-focused, low-impact instruction in a social setting
- Wedding first-dance and quinceañera choreography
- Studio rental for private events, rehearsals, and photography
